summary: Martin Marietta Materials filed an 8-K announcing the consummation of its acquisition of Lhoist North America (LNA) from Belgium-based LNA Holding. Consideration was approximately $7 billion in cash plus 10,953,543 newly issued Martin Marietta shares valued at $6.5 billion (based on a 15-day VWAP), as set in the Securities Sale Agreement dated June 27, 2026. At closing, Martin Marietta entered a shareholders agreement with LNA Holding, including a lock-up on the Consideration Shares (50% released at 12 months, 50% at 24 months) and a board seat designation. The transaction closed on August 21, 2026; watch for post-closing integration and lock-up expirations.
